name: Yalt Loyalty Program for WooCommerce
author: yaltco

sections.description:
Connect WooCommerce to the loyalty program you manage in Yalt. Enter your API details in WordPress, choose where loyalty content appears, and sync opted-in members and eligible paid orders with Yalt.

Customers can opt in when they register or at checkout. Members can view their balance and loyalty activity in My Account, browse rewards, claim available loyalty-card rewards with points, and see reward codes. Eligible cashback and discount rewards can be applied to an order. The plugin can also show estimated earnings while customers shop and points earned after purchase.

Features include:

  • Synchronize paid WooCommerce orders with Yalt.
  • Register customers for your Yalt loyalty program from account registration or checkout.
  • Display loyalty balances, purchase history, and available rewards in WooCommerce customer accounts.
  • Browse a paginated reward store and claim loyalty card rewards with points.
  • Let customers apply eligible cashback or rewards during checkout.
  • Show estimated points on product, cart, and checkout pages, and points earned on the order confirmation page.
  • Add loyalty registration and earnings calculator content with shortcodes.
  • Add the Yalt Rewards banner block or the [yalt_rewards_banner] shortcode to any page.
  • Configure display text and placement from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Reverse earned points on cancellation or refund and restore used Yalt rewards/cashback on full reversal.
  • Use bundled Spanish, Portuguese (Portugal/Brazil), and French translations.

See the Yalt WooCommerce integration.

For business enquiries, contact hello@yalt.co. For plugin support and user requests, contact support@yalt.co or use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.

External Services

This plugin connects to Yalt, an external loyalty platform, using the API base URL and API key configured by the store owner.

The plugin contacts Yalt to retrieve the loyalty program configuration. When displaying estimated loyalty earnings, it sends the amount being calculated. Customer balances and rewards are requested only for customers whose loyalty-program consent is recorded. When a customer joins the program, it sends the customer’s external ID, email address, phone number, first name, and last name. When an enrolled customer places an eligible order, it sends the external ID and order details, including order ID, totals, currency, tax, payment method, status, date, and purchased product details.

When a member claims a reward, the plugin sends the reward ID and member’s external ID to Yalt, which checks eligibility, deducts the required points, and returns the member’s reward record. The Yalt API uses the configured API key for authentication. Review the Yalt Terms of Service for information about the service. The store owner should also provide a privacy notice that accurately describes this WooCommerce data sharing to their customers.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate the Yalt Loyalty Program for WooCommerce plugin.
  3. Create or access your Yalt business account and configure a loyalty program.
  4. In WordPress, open Yalt Loyalty > Settings > Connection and enter your Yalt API base URL and API key.
  5. Save the settings to test the connection; the plugin detects and stores the chain ID from the API key.
  6. Choose where to display loyalty registration, points, balances, and rewards in the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Yalt account?

Yes. Create or access a Yalt business account and configure a loyalty program before connecting the plugin. This v1 plugin connects with an API base URL and API key, then detects the chain ID from the API.

Where is loyalty data stored?

WooCommerce remains your store platform. The plugin sends enrolled customers’ details and eligible order data to Yalt so the service can calculate and manage loyalty activity. See the External Services section for details, and ensure your store’s privacy notice explains this data sharing.

Can customers earn points in a physical shop as well?

The plugin synchronizes eligible WooCommerce orders with the Yalt chain configured for your store. Other channels depend on your Yalt plan and setup. Contact Yalt to confirm which channels are available for your account.

How can I get help?

Post in the plugin’s WordPress.org support forum or email support@yalt.co. For business enquiries, email hello@yalt.co.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Connect with Yalt from WordPress: confirm your email with a 6-digit code, then link one of your brands or create a free program. No API key to paste.
  • Orders, rewards and cashback reach Yalt through signed WooCommerce webhooks installed on connect.
  • A staging copy of the site pauses its Yalt webhooks and never disconnects the live store.
  • The pasted API key keeps working under Settings > Advanced.
  • Reconcile cancellations and cumulative refunds without duplicate point deductions or benefit restoration.
  • Restore Yalt discount reward codes and cashback on full cancellation/refund; reverse earned points proportionally for partial refunds.
  • Rewards button and panel for shoppers: join with two separate unticked consent boxes, balance, level, rewards, coupons, ways to earn, referral link, activity and the wallet card.
  • One-tap rewards: a reward bought with points goes in the cart as a coupon restricted to the member, keeping other codes. Cashback is used with an amount field.
  • Rewards box in the classic and block cart and checkout, join box at checkout and sign up, points earned on the thank-you page and in the order email.
  • Rewards banner block and [yalt_rewards_banner] shortcode, Rewards tab at My Account > Rewards.
  • Store assets screen: label, colour, position, texts and where each piece shows. No custom CSS or code.

0.6.4

  • Fix the default Yalt API endpoint for new and existing connections.

0.6.3

  • Add French, Spanish, European Portuguese, and Italian translations.

0.6.1

  • Let customers apply an already claimed discount reward at checkout and mark it used after the order is processed.

0.6.0

  • Add a paginated rewards store to My Club and let members claim rewards with points.
  • Show member redemption codes after a successful claim.

0.5.0

  • Add customer rewards and loyalty journey views to WooCommerce accounts.
  • Improve order and customer loyalty synchronization.
